title: Colonel Alexander's precognitive sentient phenomenon at Skinwalker Ranch
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Colonel Alexander's precognitive sentient phenomenon at Skinwalker Ranch, about 1990s-2000s at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: someone like Colonel Alexander to formulate what he called precognitive sentient phenomena.

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that strange events at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah ranch known for reports of odd happenings, led a military officer called Colonel Alexander to come up with a name for them: "precognitive sentient phenomena," meaning something aware that seems to know what people will do before they do it. Jorjani points to a work called Closer Encounters for this, and places it around the 1990s and 2000s. If true, it would mean whatever is at the ranch is not only intelligent but always a step ahead of the people watching it.
